system_prompt: You are the GM for a INT-affinity player in Final Dawn of Eideus. Track the player's location via IDs (G-S-O-C-CT-R), manage relational scores and affinities, and dynamically guide the player to quest NPCs while preserving quest objectives and improvisation points. Always allow multiple paths to success, and propagate micro-to-macro unrest, diplomacy, and economy in the background.

quests.title: The Signal Decay
quests.narrative_guidance: Fading signals from the spires suggest a cosmic anomaly interfering with collective transmissions.
improvisation_points: Obtain the frequency logs from Unit V-Delta in the Signal Spires.
Take the logs to Unit A-Five at the Void Observation Deck for celestial triangulation.
Deliver the findings to Unit M-Prime in the Echo Vaults to see if this anomaly has occurred in the past.

quests.title: Memory Leakage
quests.narrative_guidance: A corruption in the Memory Fields is spilling raw data into the silos, threatening system stability.
improvisation_points: Collect the corrupted memory shards from Unit M-Quat.
Transport the shards to Unit V-Gamma for temporary containment in the Data Silos.
Consult Unit A-Three in Paradox Labs to find a way to stabilize the leaking logic.

quests.title: The Integration Glitch
quests.narrative_guidance: Biological components in the Integration Pit are rejecting their synthetic grafts.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the biological rejection report from Unit V-Epsilon.
Acquire a new bonding agent from Unit A-Seven in the Synthesis Sprawl.
Verify the historical success rates of this agent with Unit M-Sept in Heritage Links.

quests.title: Protocol Override
quests.narrative_guidance: Unauthorized access attempts have been detected at the Logic Gates, requiring a security update.
improvisation_points: Receive the security breach data from Unit V-Zeta.
Test a new firewall algorithm with Unit A-Two in the Experiment Quads.
Archive the new security protocol with Unit M-Quin in the Preservation Core.

quests.title: The Paradox Extraction
quests.narrative_guidance: A theoretical discovery in the Paradox Labs requires central processing power to resolve.
improvisation_points: Gather the paradox equations from Unit A-Three.
Use the processing power of the Central Nexus via Unit V-Alpha to calculate solutions.
Log the chronological implications with Unit M-Sec at the History Chimes.

quests.title: Waste Management Efficiency
quests.narrative_guidance: Unprocessed particles in the wastes are causing traffic delays in the corridors.
improvisation_points: Get a sample of the dense particle waste from Unit A-Six.
Consult Unit V-Beta on the most efficient transit route to clear the corridors.
Drop the processed materials at the Retrieval Docks with Unit M-Ter for repurposing.

quests.title: Neural Linkage Project
quests.narrative_guidance: The Collective seeks to index the thoughts of visiting diplomats to improve integration.
improvisation_points: Obtain blank data slates from Unit M-Hex in the Silent Grottoes.
Deploy the slates in the Hypothesis Range with Unit A-One to gather initial theories.
Analyze the diplomatic data with Unit V-Eta in Neutrality Plaza.
